name: DJ! Join Us!
source:
Aki just wanted to pursue her dreams quietly.

She's a shy nerd who hides in the back of class, nursing a hopeless crush on the perfect, popular girl Miyuki. School feels lonely, but she has one place where she truly belongs: the VR Idol contest, where she performs as DJ Bugsypop! 

When she’s suddenly paired with the stylish, confident Idol Luvly, their duo takes off overnight. Together, Aki's dream of being a musician might really come true!

Except Luvly isn’t just anyone. She’s Miyuki, the girl Aki’s admired from afar all along?! Now, without either of them realizing, they’re falling in love all over again! 

But if their identities ever get out? Aki might lose the one place she finally feels like she belongs.

[From [url=https://dj-ashley.itch.io/dj-join-us]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
阿琪只想安静地追求自己的梦想。

她是一个害羞的书呆子，躲在教室后面，对完美、受欢迎的女孩美雪有着无可救药的迷恋。学校让人感到孤独，但她有一个真正属于她的地方：VR偶像大赛，她在其中扮演DJ Bugsypop！

当她突然与时尚、自信的偶像Luvly搭档时，他们的搭档一夜成名。在一起，Aki成为音乐家的梦想可能真的会实现！

但Luvly并不是普通人。她就是深雪，亚纪一直仰慕的女孩？！现在，他们谁也没意识到，他们又坠入爱河了！

但如果他们的身份泄露出去呢？阿琪可能会失去她最终感觉属于自己的地方。

[来自[url=https://dj-ashley.itch.io/dj-join-us]itch.io[/url]]
